$comment: Path prefix → publishing repository. Prefixes are permanent once an IRI under them is published (ADR-0001, inheriting metawork-ontology ADR-0004). mode: 'project-site' = served from <origin>/<repo><path>; 'custom-domain' = passed through to the Pages custom domain (owned by this hub repo, so only the hub's own paths use it). turtle: the ontology's machine-readable file, the 303 target for RDF requests and routed to the same repo. title/source: shown on the landing page. listed: false hides an entry from the landing page (routing still works) until the ontology's first public release. Turtle rule (ADR-0002): turtle is /<name>.ttl at the root, never under the prefix.
